memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On the seventh day Elishama son of Ammihud, the leader of the people of Ephraim... On the eighth day Gamaliel son of Pedahzur, the leader of the people of Manasseh... On the ninth day Abidan son of Gideoni, the leader of the people of Benjamin... On the tenth day Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, the leader of the people of Dan... On the eleventh day Pagiel son of Okran, the leader of the people of Asher. [Each brought the identical offering.] - Num 7:48-77 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is something remarkable. Since every offering was identical, God could have summed the whole thing up in a single sentence: "All twelve leaders brought the same gift." But He did not. Instead, He devoted many verses to recording each leader by name, each tribe by name, and each offering in full detail — twelve times over.

Why would God spend so much of His Word repeating what could have been said once? Because He does not lump His people together into a faceless crowd. Each leader's gift mattered to Him individually. Each name was worth recording. Each act of devotion was seen and treasured on its own.

This is who our God is. He is not too busy or too great to notice the individual. In a world of billions, He knows you by name. Your prayers, your gifts, your quiet acts of faithfulness are not swallowed up in the crowd. God records each one personally, as if you were the only one.

Jesus said that even the hairs of our head are numbered (Matt 10:30), and that God knows His own sheep by name (John 10:3). The same God who carefully wrote down each of these twelve gifts sees and treasures every offering of your heart.

You are not just one of many to God. You are known, named, and remembered. Bring your offering to Him today, knowing He receives it as uniquely yours.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God notices you individually, not just in the crowd?
- How does it comfort you that God records each act of devotion?
- What offering of your heart can you bring, knowing He sees it?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You know me by name and treasure each offering of my heart. Help me to serve You today knowing I am seen and remembered. Amen.
